description: Saves a new Scanner, as Save on New Scanner does: question (required), and optionally name, inputs, look-again timing, who gets the task, due rule, destination, contact types, and enabled (on or off; there is no trial mode). Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying. An owner-level change: Sergio tells the owner after it is made.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

reason.description: Why you are doing this, in one sentence. The owner sees it in the notice Sergio sends after the change.
